sentences.en: The impaction of the gears caused the machine to stop working.
sentences.zh: 齿轮的压紧导致机器停止工作。

sentences.en: To prevent impaction, make sure there is enough space between parts.
sentences.zh: 为了防止压紧，确保各部件之间有足够的空间。

sentences.en: The dentist had to remove the tooth because of an impaction issue.
sentences.zh: 牙医因为牙齿的嵌入问题不得不拔掉了这颗牙齿。
